method: Unchanged Enchantment subclasses, EnumEnchantmentType, EnchantmentHelper, EnchantmentData, WeightedRandom, ItemEnchantedBook, ItemStack and ContainerEnchantment after Block/Item registration. Doubles: constructor-less World whose getBlock reads a 5x2x5 fixture around the table (native isAirBlock), constructor-less EntityPlayer with experience fields and capabilities only, constructor-less EntityLivingBase exposing held item, last-active items and creature attribute. The static EnchantmentHelper Random and the container Random are reseeded by reflection. All case inputs are printed with each record. HashMap iteration order is that of the recording JVM (Java 8+ HashMap; small Integer keys hash to themselves). Records: registry, item applicability over every registered item, slot levels, mapEnchantmentData, buildEnchantmentList/addRandomEnchantment, table sequences, armour damage modifier, living modifier, entity getters, unbreaking damage skips, thorns rolls and NBT helpers. Not covered: rendering, GUI, packets, sounds and entity side effects (thorns damage, bane slowness, fire aspect, knockback motion).
